description.plain:
The Trail Blazer is here – the ultimate trail and hiking shoe designed for those who crave both performance and comfort on rugged terrain. This wider version of the Trailhead offers a secure, roomy fit, making it the perfect choice for those who need extra space without compromising support. It features the Trail Traction Outsole, seen on the Primal Pursuit, with a full rubber outsole and aggressive lugs that provide superior traction, cushion, and grip for a stable, comfortable experience on any trail. With its zero drop design, the Trail Blazer promotes natural alignment and a closer connection to the ground. The shoe also boasts a breathable air mesh upper combined with microfiber, wicking away moisture to keep your feet cool and dry. Available in four stylish colorways, the Trail Blazer seamlessly blends performance with versatility.

Lightweight yet durable, the Trail Blazer is built for adventurers who value comfort, breathability, and reliable performance. Whether you're conquering challenging hikes or going for your daily run, these shoes will keep you moving with ease and confidence. Ready for your next outdoor adventure? So are we.

products.title: Altra Running Men's Lone Peak 9 Trail Shoes

description.plain:
Harness the freedom and confidence to go after legendary adventures on the trail in a shoe that's been doing it for years. Make memories for miles. The Lone Peak 9 is Altra's iconic all-around trail runner — built for trail running, hiking, and thru hiking with a max-cushion stack, StoneGuard™ rock plate, and grippy MaxTrac™ outsole. The original FootShape™ fit gives you the roomiest toe box for natural movement and stability on technical terrain, while Altra EGO™ midsole foam delivers a responsive, connected feel underfoot. GaiterTrap™ lets you strap on a Trail Gaiter in seconds for debris-free miles on dusty or muddy trails. Available in Regular and Wide widths.

Original FootShape™ Fit
With Altra's signature FootShape™ fit, you get our roomiest toe box with plenty of room to help your toes move freely, and space through the midfoot for natural movement on technical terrain.
Available in Wide Width
The Lone Peak 9 is offered in both Regular and Wide widths so you can find the perfect fit for broader feet — extra room through the forefoot and toe box for natural spread.
MaxTrac™ Trail Grip
Our grippy MaxTrac™ outsole provides the perfect combination of grip, traction, and durability on all types of terrain — from smooth dirt to rocky scrambles.
Altra EGO™ Midsole
Connect with the ground and stay comfortable with unique Altra EGO™ midsole foam — responsive cushioning for the long haul.
StoneGuard™ Rock Protection
A StoneGuard™ provides underfoot protection on the trail, over rocks, debris, and tough terrain with a flexible yet firm and stable feel.
GaiterTrap™ Trail Gaiter Tab
GaiterTrap™, our unique hook-and-loop tab, allows for easy strapless gaiter attachment without fasteners, bungees, or bindings. Trail debris in your shoes? No thanks.
APMA Seal of Acceptance
This product received the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) Seal of Acceptance, awarded to products found to promote good foot health.

description.plain:
Built for speed, agility, and raw trail feedback, the Strappers are the ultimate barefoot trail running shoes for off-road runners. Featuring an integrated, secure strap system, these shoes lock your midfoot down over a thin, highly flexible sole, preventing internal slipping during steep descents and sharp turns.

Designed for pure barefoot running, the Strappers remove thick midsoles to let your feet react instantly to rocks, roots, and changes in the dirt. The flat, zero drop design encourages a midfoot strike, reducing joint impact and strengthening your lower legs naturally.

The wide toe box provides the necessary room for your forefoot to splay and stabilize your landing. A puncture-resistant, high-grip rubber outsole keeps you grounded on loose dirt, wet grass, and rugged terrain without adding weight. The breathable, debris-defying mesh upper keeps your feet clean and cool. Lace up the Strappers and discover a fast, natural, and completely connected trail running experience.

RUN FAST EVERY DAY.
These Terrex Agravic 3 Trail Running Shoes are built for comfort, speed and stability for those who run the trails daily.
They offer the ultimate blend of comfort, durability, and protection for routine trail running. A breathable upper supports cool, dry feet, and a Lightstrike 2.0 midsole ensures a plush feel, stability, and responsive cushioning across rough surfaces. A 4mm lugged outsole and Continental® Rubber provides confident footing on loose and slippery terrain.

This product features at least 20% recycled materials. By reusing materials that have already been created, we help to reduce waste and our reliance on finite resources and reduce the footprint of the products we make.

Features:

  • Regular fit
  • Lace closure
  • Textile and synthetic upper with abrasion-resistant overlays
  • Lightstrike cushioning
  • TPU stability plate
  • Gusseted tongue
  • Midsole drop: 8 mm (heel: 31 mm / forefoot: 23 mm)
  • Continental™ Rubber outsole with 4 mm inner lugs and 5 mm outer lugs
  • Contains at least 20% recycled content

products.title: Brooks Divide 6 Mens Trail Running Shoes - Brown

description.plain:
Hit the road — or the trails — in the men’s Divide 6. The soft cushioning and all-terrain traction of these hybrid trail-running shoes helps you feel comfortable and confident on the go.

Road-to-trail versatility
Soft DNA LOFT v2 cushioning provides a smooth ride on roads and trails while grippy lugs deliver traction on off-road surfaces.
Familiar road-shoe fit
Road-shoe-inspired fit features breathable mesh upper and a protective toe cap to help guard against roots, rocks, and trail debris.
Superior traction
TrailTack Green outsole is made with 25% recycled content and offers all-terrain traction in wet and dry conditions.

Features:

  • Breathable Mesh Upper - Allows cool air to flow.
  • Padded Tongue - Eradicates chafing and rubbing.
  • Overlays - Increases durability.
  • Toe Protector - Protects the toe from rocks and uneven surfaces.
  • Traditional Lacing System - Locks the midfoot for a secure fit.
  • DNA Loft V2 Midsole - Lighter-weight, softer cushioning for a plush feel.
  • TrailTack Green Rubber Outsole - Provides optimal grip and traction and made with 25% recycled materials.
  • Flex Grooves - Increase flexibility for better grip and traction.
  • Drop - 8mm.
  • Weight - 294g.

products.title: Keen Men's Wander Trail Running Shoe

description.plain:
Stay grounded in Wander, our agile trail runner with lower-profile cushioning plus a rock plate for stability and a closer-to-trail feel. Featuring a compression-resistant KEEN.ReGENX midsole enhanced with EcoEnd to biodegrade at end-of-life.

Features
  • Original Fit has generous space across the forefoot for toes to splay
  • Contoured arch for midfoot support
  • Tie lace system
  • Light, compression-resistant KEEN.ReGENX foam with nearly 70% energy return
  • Removable, resilient foam insole for long-lasting cushioning
  • KEEN.ALL-TERRAIN rubber outsole for higher-traction grip
  • Multi-directional lug pattern provides superior traction
  • Contoured heel lock for a more secure fit
  • ESS bruise plate for protection on uneven surfaces
  • Eco Anti-Odor for natural, pesticide-free odor control
  • Weight per shoe 9.77oz / 277g

  • Heel Height 1.02in / 26mm

  • Heel-to-Toe Drop 0.16in / 4mm
Materials
  • Performance mesh and synthetic upper
  • Breathable mesh lining
  • Non-marking rubber outsole
Care
  • Gently brush with a soft, damp sponge to remove loose dirt. Treat stains right away with a gentle cleaner. Air dry away from heat.
